description: A standalone editor for configuring recurring event rules in iCal RRULE format. Supports Daily, Weekly, Monthly, and Yearly patterns with flexible end conditions.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The recurrence rule value (iCal RRULE string).

parameters.name: ShowSummary
parameters.description: Whether to show the generated RRULE summary. Default is true.

parameters.name: StartDate
parameters.description: The start date used when parsing the rule. Default is today.
